newsitem.title: UK: NWE OIL PRODUCTS EASE - GASOLINE BY UP TO $8.
newsitem.headline: NWE OIL PRODUCTS EASE - GASOLINE BY UP TO $8.

text.p: NWE oil products were lower on Monday, dealers said.
Gasoline slipped up to $8 a tonne as losses suffered late last week were extended. The end of a squeeze and fresh supplies from the end of this week were two factors for the drop.

Gas oil's outright price eased 75 cents to $1, in line with an easier August IPE whcih traded at $168.75 a tonne. Heating oil barge spreads were talked some 25 cents firmer, with prompt Rotterdam refinery around August IPE +$0.50/1.00.
High sulphur fuel oil barges were steady at $93.50/$94.50 for RMG material and $95 fob ARA for refinery product.
But late talk dipped a little. Cargoes were offered up to $3 lower at $85 fob with swaps down to $93.25/$94 for August.
